notes.title: Roboggled Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
🎮 Roboggled Demo Now Available!
Try before you buy! We're thrilled to announce that the official demo for Roboggled is now live on Steam!

🚀 Play the first 20 levels of the game!

🎉 Play, Share, and Give Feedback!
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Share your experience in the Community Hub to chat with the devs and other players. If you purchase the game, please leave us a review! It could help shape future updates to this game or our other games!

✅ Add to Your Wishlist!
If you enjoy the demo, but don't want to purchase it yet, don’t forget to Wishlist the full game to stay updated on future updates.

notes.title: Music change and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Removed one of the songs that induced anxiety instead of calmness
[*] Fixed a possible crash when backing out of the custom levels menu
[*] Updated the json library to a newer version
[/list]

notes.title: Roboggled is a nice casual Sokoban inspired block pushing puzzler out now
notes.notes:
Developed on Linux with the excellent Godot Engine, we have the Sokoban like block-pushing puzzle game Roboggled.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/roboggled-is-a-nice-casual-sokoban-inspired-block-pushing-puzzler-out-now

notes.title: Puzzle reset button and better drop point contrast.
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Drop points are now black instead of white to contrast against the floor.
[*] Added a full reset button to start a puzzle over without having to exit and re-enter the level.
[/list]

notes.title: Fixed a stutter with lower framerates
notes.notes:
Fixed a severe stutter with player movement on lower framerates
Note: The robot still stutters a bit on lower framerates, but it should be much better now.

Fixed a bug with Steam achievements when the game is unable to connect to Steamworks
